crossRefs.note: The sons of Kohath: Amram, Izhar, and Hebron, and Uzziel.
The sons of Kohath: Amram, Izhar, Hebron, and Uzziel, four.
The sons of Hebron: Jeriah the chief, Amariah the second, Jahaziel the third, and Jekameam the fourth.
Of the Amramites, of the Izharites, of the Hebronites, of the Uzzielites:
Of the Hebronites, Hashabiah and his brothers, men of valor, one thousand seven hundred, had the oversight of Israel…
Of the Hebronites, Jerijah was the chief, even of the Hebronites, according to their generations by fathers’…
The sons of Kohath: Amram, and Izhar, and Hebron, and Uzziel; and the years of the life of Kohath were one hundred…
These are the families of Levi: the family of the Libnites, the family of the Hebronites, the family of the Mahlites…

people.name: Eliel
people.line: Levite leader who assisted in bringing the ark to Jerusalem

people.name: Hebron
people.line: Son of Kohath, grandson of Levi.
